macros.name: silly
macros.doc: Use the macro \silly on a LaTeX ⟨counter⟩ to typeset the corresponding image for the value of that counter.

macros.name: sillynumeral
macros.doc: Provides the silly numeral system representation from the provided ⟨integer⟩ value.

macros.name: sillystep
macros.doc: Prints the step number ⟨integer⟩ from the sequence of steps.
